title: Corporate training
lead: Register your employees for live, remote programmes. We train teams worldwide in cybersecurity, cloud, DevOps, data, AI, and software engineering.

benefits.title: Live, not leftover videos
benefits.text: Your staff join instructor-led sessions and labs, with the same standard we use for public cohorts.

benefits.title: Fit your headcount
benefits.text: Place people on an upcoming cohort, or ask for a private group if you have a larger team and a preferred calendar.

benefits.title: Clear next steps
benefits.text: After you submit this form we confirm programmes, dates, fees, and a single billing contact by email or phone.
